app.name: Transcend Climate
app.tagline: Climate monitoring for Nigeria and Africa
loading.webgl: This app needs WebGL. Try a recent browser, or turn on hardware acceleration in its settings.
noscript: Transcend Climate needs JavaScript to run.
panel.datasaver.hint: Flat terrain and lighter imagery to use less data.
layer.lst.desc: Daytime land surface temperature seen from satellite.
layer.clouds.desc: Fraction of each area covered by cloud.
layer.forestloss.desc: Forest lost since 2001, shown in red (Hansen/UMD).
layer.aod.desc: Airborne particles such as Harmattan dust and smoke.
layer.no2.desc: Pollution from burning fuel, traffic and industry.
layer.co.desc: Smoke and burning, measured at mid-atmosphere.
layer.emissions.desc: Estimated greenhouse gas emissions by facility.
status.needs_key.hint: An administrator needs to add an OpenAQ key on the server.
time.hint: Satellite data arrives 1 to 6 days after it is recorded, so the newest date can differ by layer.
map.unavailable: {name} is not set up on this server.
chat.title: Ask the globe
chat.mic.unsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
chat.mic.privacy: Voice input is handled by your browser and may send audio to its provider.
chat.mic.error: Could not hear that. Please try again.
chat.mode.offline: Basic commands only. An administrator can turn on full language understanding.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
chat.example.3: how hot is Lagos compared to normal?
nlp.help: I can show or hide layers, go to places, change the date, mark places, show facility emissions, compare a place with normal, and switch language. Try: show rainfall over Kano.
nlp.not_understood: I did not understand that. Try a command such as: show rainfall over Kano.
nlp.place_not_found: I could not find that place.
nlp.climate_unavailable: I could not get climate data for that place right now.
nlp.llm_unavailable: The language service is unavailable, so only basic commands work right now.
nlp.refused: I can't help with that request.
nlp.budget_exhausted: The daily limit for language understanding has been reached. Basic commands still work.
card.climate.title: Compared with normal
card.climate.error: Climate data is unavailable for this spot right now.
card.climate.chart: Monthly temperature difference from normal, last 12 months
emissions.total: {total} Mt CO₂e across the {count} largest facilities in {year}
emissions.estimate: Modelled estimate, not a direct measurement.
about.title: About Transcend Climate
about.body: Transcend Climate shows live satellite and open climate data for Nigeria and Africa. It is free to use and open source. Some data lags real time by days, and emissions figures are modelled estimates.
about.translation: Translations other than English are machine-drafted and not yet reviewed by native speakers. Please tell us what to fix.
lang.draft.hint: Machine-drafted and not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
